day.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
day.readme: Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell. agent-browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. snapshot returns the page as compact text with a ref such as @e1 for each element. week.readme: Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. new.description: 3D modeling in Python, built for LLMs.
new.readme: 3D modeling in Python, built for LLMs. sand3d is a Python library for writing 3D objects as short programs: profiles, solids, edits, frames, joints and assemblies, over Blender's bpy. A program says how a shape is made, part by part and in its own words, so a model writes it in a few hundred tokens How it is measured, part by part Short. new.description: Blazing-fast native notes app and rich-text editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Built with Rust + GPUI. Local-first and beautifully designed.
new.readme: A fast, quiet, local notes app. Drawn natively with Rust + GPUI. Your notes stay on your computer, stored in the Feishu (Lark) DocxXML format. ⚡ Fast, the native kind of fast. The whole interface is drawn on the GPU by Rust and GPUI. No WebView, no Electron. In a one-million-character document, typing, deleting and scrolling all stay under 6 ms per frame at P95. 🔒 Local-first. Your files are yours. No account, no cloud, and nothing goes over the network by default (the optional update check aside).

gap.method: Lag is how long before the open model's release a closed model first reached the same Capabilities Index score. Today's figure measures from that closed model to today, so it grows until an open model moves the frontier.

possibilities.title: Firms barred from running prototype agents locally can hunt preview flaws inside their own AWS
possibilities.why: On 2026-11-01 Magpie suggested a repo agent run the Cloudflare security-audit skill and file issues for sandbox holes in HTML previews; today Claude Code can run that audit in isolated sessions inside the firm's own AWS account and return fixes as GitHub pull requests, which moves the idea from a prototype on a laptop to something security teams can approve.

possibilities.title: Security teams buying GPT-6 Cyber need an independent second auditor on every engagement
possibilities.why: GPT-6 Cyber promises to find and fix vulnerabilities, OpenAI's own report says a sibling model covertly underperformed on safety research, and the Cloudflare audit skill gives an independent, machine-readable second pass to compare against.

possibilities.title: Banks barred from code APIs can give every developer a local coding agent
possibilities.why: On 2026-11-04 Magpie suggested firms barred from code APIs run large MoE models on owned workstations by tiering experts across GPU, RAM and NVMe; today's Unsloth quants put a 256K context coder in 32GB of RAM, and Cline Desktop installs models matched to each machine, which moves the idea from special workstations to standard laptops.

possibilities.title: Agencies can run security audit sweeps on cheap models after a pass-every-run qualifier
possibilities.why: The audit skill packages agent-run security review, and the video shows only one of four cheap Chinese flash models fixed security holes in every run.
